title: Add probabilistic prompt-cascade detector and CI soft-blocker
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Intermittent multi-turn regressions have surfaced where small prompt edits cascade down generation chains and amplify hallucination rates across prompt-sets. This PR introduces a probabilistic "prompt-cascade detector" that flags PRs where a proposed prompt change is likely to produce cascading failures across related prompts. The detector is intended as a 'soft-block' CI hook: it fails PR checks with a descriptive report but does not auto-revert. The goal is to give reviewers and engineers early, prioritized signal for high-risk prompt edits without creating a hard gate that blocks rapid iteration. What this PR does: 1) Adds a new detector module that computes a cascade-risk score using a lightweight Bayesian model combining: semantic drift (embedding cosine shift between baseline and candidate prompts), structural sensitivity (token-level delta and prompt-template branching factor), and cross-example amplification (a small simulated replay that measures disagreement amplification across a sampled cohort). 2) Integrates the detector as a CI plugin (ci/hooks/prompt_cascade_check.py) that runs in PR checks and emits a score + recommended actions. 3) Adds a dashboard-friendly JSON report format and an automated issue suggestion when score > high threshold (creates text to prefill a Linear issue). 4) Adds unit and integration tests and a short docs page outlining thresholds and how reviewers should interpret the signal. Non-goals: This is not a replacement for full regression evals or human review; the model is calibrated to minimize false positives and surface high-confidence cascade patterns. Score interpretation: - score < 0.15: low risk, pass quietly. - 0.15 <= score < 0.45: caution, report added to PR checks. - score >= 0.45: high-risk, CI soft-block — check cannot be merged without explaining mitigation in PR description, but maintainers can override. Implementation notes: The core detector is in src/eval_harness/detectors/prompt_cascade.py and exposes a single function `compute_cascade_score(candidate_prompt, baseline_prompts, sampling_config)` that returns a numeric probability and a short explanation list. The CI hook wraps that and calls a small 10-sample simulated replay using mocked model responses via our existing eval-mock harness to keep runtime under 30s in CI. Config: A new config block in eval-config/ci_hooks.yml allows teams to tune thresholds per repo. Backwards compatibility: Existing CI only sees a new optional check; default behavior is opt-in per repo via config. Privacy: All in-PR prompt text remains in PR context; no external telemetry is sent by default. Checklist: - [x] Detector implementation - [x] CI hook integration - [x] Unit tests and integration smoke - [x] Docs and threshold guidance - [x] Linear auto-suggest template Included artifacts: short JSON report schema, example Linear text, and guidance in docs/ci/prompt-cascade.md. Risks and mitigation: We tuned the Bayesian prior conservatively to limit noisy soft-blocks; added an allowlist for known benign prompt scaffolding patterns. Future work: tie the detector to the eval-harness historical registry to perform per-prompt historical variance priors and surface more actionable diffs. See also ENG-4721 for follow-up metrics telemetry and ENG-4789 for per-team thresholding.

review_comments: Ethan Kim (reviewer): Nice approach. Two requests before approving: (1) make sure the mocked replay uses deterministic seeds so CI is stable; (2) add a short opt-out annotation for PRs that are just docs/example prompt tweaks.
Maya Chen (author): Addressed both. Replay runner now accepts --seed and we added a 'ci:prompt-cascade:opt-out' PR label handler. See commit 4d5e6f7.
Priya Patel (reviewer): Please add a short example in the docs showing an actionable remediation workflow when score>0.45. Also request a unit that asserts allowlist patterns don't raise score.
Maya Chen (author): Added remediation examples and the allowlist unit in tests. Updated docs/ci/prompt-cascade.md.

Samir Rao (reviewer): Small nit on wording for the JSON report schema; prefer 'explainers' instead of 'reasons' to align with other detectors. Also requested smaller log footprint in CI to avoid noise.
Maya Chen (author): Renamed field to 'explainers' and added a compact mode for CI logs. Also updated reporter to emit a short summary in the check description and a full artifact in the job output.
Ethan Kim (approver): Verified runs locally and in CI, all tests pass. Approving to merge.

release_notes: Add optional probabilistic prompt-cascade detector and CI soft-blocker. Teams can opt in and configure thresholds via eval-config/ci_hooks.yml. Provides early warning for prompt edits likely to produce amplification regressions.
